text.description_html:
Omnia #43 Sleek Designer Stainless Steel Levers

The Omnia #43 Stainless Steel Levers are slim and sleek in appearance, yet very strong by design. Every piece is extra durable, made from premium grade stainless steel coupled with interior components that prove worthy of Omnia's exceptional quality standards. And since it is all one piece with no grooves, it is easy to keep clean, making it ideal for high-traffic areas.

Specifications for Omnia #43 Sleek Stainless Steel Levers pair

  • Lever Pair only
  • Lever Length: 4-7/8"
  • Lever Projection: 2-5/8"
  • Lever Diameter (thickness): 11/16"
  • Commercial and Residential Doors
  • Solid Stainless Steel
  • Brushed Stainless Steel Finish

The Omnia #43 Leverset is only available in Brushed Stainless Steel.
